why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Check whether you're allowed. The terms exclude US residents and other groups, and the app's code lists the United States, Canada and all 27 EU countries as blocked regions. The terms add: "Use of a virtual private network (VPN) or any other technology to circumvent these restrictions is strictly prohibited."
Open app.nuva.finance and connect a wallet on Ethereum. The FAQ misprints the address as "app.nuva.finance.com", so type it yourself.
Hold the vault token, and watch the Points Hub for the start of Season 1.
costs: The minimum deposit is 1 USDC, plus Ethereum gas. The FAQ says: "During the launch period, all fees are waived." It gives no end date, and the app shows a 0.1% protocol fee crossed out. Each vault's own management and performance fees come out of its yield. Withdrawals can take up to three US business days.
risks: Season 1 has no start date, and the points earned so far have no published value. You must be at least 18. No identity documents are asked for vaults, though the terms keep the right to require them. NUVA's pages disagree about control. The terms say "NUVA cannot modify smart contract logic, disable or pause functions", while another page lists a "Global pause authority". The audits page lists She
